import h5py, numpy as np, time
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment

REQ=['PABPC1','NUDT21','LEO1']

def decode_arr(arr):
    return np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(x) for x in arr])

def read_h5ad(fn):
    t=time.time(); print('reading', fn, flush=True)
    with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
        shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape'])
        data=f['X/data'][()].astype(np.float32)
        indices=f['X/indices'][()]
        indptr=f['X/indptr'][()]
        X=sparse.csc_matrix((data,indices,indptr), shape=shape)
        var=decode_arr(f['var/_index'][()])
        cats=decode_arr(f['obs/guide/categories'][()])
        codes=f['obs/guide/codes'][()]
        guides=cats[codes]
        if 'target_gene' in f['obs']:
            tcats=decode_arr(f['obs/target_gene/categories'][()])
            tcodes=f['obs/target_gene/codes'][()]
            targets=tcats[tcodes]
        else:
            targets=None
    print(' done', X.shape, 'nnz', X.nnz, 'time', time.time()-t, flush=True)
    return X,var,guides,cats,targets

def lognorm(X):
    # X csc cells x genes
    totals=np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
    totals[totals==0]=1
    X=X.tocoo(copy=True)
    X.data=np.log1p(X.data/totals[X.row]*1e4).astype(np.float32)
    return X.tocsr()

def group_means(Xcsr, labels, groups):
    # groups order list
    out=np.zeros((len(groups), Xcsr.shape[1]), dtype=np.float32)
    sizes=np.zeros(len(groups), dtype=int)
    for i,g in enumerate(groups):
        idx=np.flatnonzero(labels==g)
        sizes[i]=len(idx)
        if len(idx):
            out[i]=np.asarray(Xcsr[idx].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    return out, sizes

Xr,varr,gr,gr_cats,tr=read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
Xq,varq,gq,gq_cats,tq=read_h5ad('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
print('vars equal', np.array_equal(varr,varq), flush=True)

# map ref guide to target
ref_map={}
for guide in gr_cats:
    vals=tr[gr==guide]
    if len(vals):
        u,c=np.unique(vals, return_counts=True)
        ref_map[guide]=u[c.argmax()]
print('ref requested guides', {gene:[g for g,t in ref_map.items() if t==gene] for gene in REQ}, flush=True)

Xrl=lognorm(Xr); Xql=lognorm(Xq)
ref_groups=list(gr_cats)
query_groups=list(gq_cats)
Mr, sr=group_means(Xrl, gr, ref_groups)
Mq, sq=group_means(Xql, gq, query_groups)
print('group sizes ref min/max', sr.min(), sr.max(), 'query', sq.min(), sq.max(), flush=True)

ref_nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(ref_groups) if g.startswith('NT-')]
q_nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(query_groups) if g.startswith('NT-')]
ref_non=[i for i,g in enumerate(ref_groups) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
q_non=[i for i,g in enumerate(query_groups) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
Er=Mr[ref_non]-Mr[ref_nt].mean(axis=0)
Eq=Mq[q_non]-Mq[q_nt].mean(axis=0)
ref_names=[ref_groups[i] for i in ref_non]
query_names=[query_groups[i] for i in q_non]

# select genes with strongest perturbation effects in either dataset; try several k
def corr_mat(A,B, idx=None):
    if idx is not None:
        A=A[:,idx]; B=B[:,idx]
    A=A.astype(np.float64); B=B.astype(np.float64)
    A=A-A.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True); B=B-B.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    An=np.sqrt((A*A).sum(axis=1)); Bn=np.sqrt((B*B).sum(axis=1))
    return (A@B.T)/(An[:,None]*Bn[None,:]+1e-12)

score=np.maximum(np.max(np.abs(Er),axis=0), np.max(np.abs(Eq),axis=0))
for k in [200,500,1000,2000,5000,Er.shape[1]]:
    idx=np.argsort(score)[-k:] if k<Er.shape[1] else None
    C=corr_mat(Er,Eq,idx)
    print('\\nK', k, 'top matches for requested ref guides')
    for gene in REQ:
        rgs=[g for g,t in ref_map.items() if t==gene]
        for rg in rgs:
            ri=ref_names.index(rg)
            order=np.argsort(C[ri])[::-1][:8]
            print(gene, rg, [(query_names[j], float(C[ri,j])) for j in order])
    # assignment all non-controls maximize corr
    rows, cols=linear_sum_assignment(-C)
    assign={ref_names[r]:query_names[c] for r,c in zip(rows,cols)}
    print('assignment requested', {gene: assign.get([g for g,t in ref_map.items() if t==gene][0]) for gene in REQ})

# Direct target expression in query per group and ref per group for requested genes
print('\\nDirect target expression query means/ranks')
for gene in REQ:
    gi=int(np.flatnonzero(varq==gene)[0])
    vals=Mq[q_non, gi]
    order=np.argsort(vals)[:10]
    print(gene, 'lowest query', [(query_names[j], float(vals[j]), int(sq[q_non[j]])) for j in order])
    print(gene, 'NT mean', float(Mq[q_nt,gi].mean()), 'all anon mean', float(vals.mean()))
print('\\nDirect target ref expression requested')
for gene in REQ:
    gi=int(np.flatnonzero(varr==gene)[0])
    vals=Mr[ref_non, gi]
    order=np.argsort(vals)[:8]
    print(gene, 'lowest ref', [(ref_names[j], ref_map[ref_names[j]], float(vals[j])) for j in order])

import h5py, numpy as np, collections
from scipy import sparse

def dec(a): return np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x,(bytes,bytearray)) else str(x) for x in a])
def read(fn):
    with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
        X=sparse.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][()].astype(np.float32), f['X/indices'][()], f['X/indptr'][()]), shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape']))
        var=dec(f['var/_index'][()])
        gc=dec(f['obs/guide/categories'][()]); labels=gc[f['obs/guide/codes'][()]]
        return X,var,gc,labels

def lognorm(X):
    totals=np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel().astype(np.float32); totals[totals==0]=1
    coo=X.tocoo(copy=True); coo.data=np.log1p(coo.data/totals[coo.row]*1e4).astype(np.float32)
    return coo.tocsr()
def mean_col_by_group(Xcsr, labels, groups, col):
    x=np.asarray(Xcsr[:,col].todense()).ravel()
    return [(g, float(x[labels==g].mean()), int((labels==g).sum())) for g in groups]
Xr,vr,grc,gr=read('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
Xq,vq,gqc,gq=read('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
Xql=lognorm(Xq); Xrl=lognorm(Xr)
q_non=[g for g in gqc if not g.startswith('NT-')]
q_nt=[g for g in gqc if g.startswith('NT-')]
for gene in ['PABPC1','NUDT21','LEO1']:
    idx=int(np.where(vr==gene)[0][0])
    print('\\n',gene,'ref idx',idx,'query name at same idx',vq[idx])

    ntmean=np.mean([v for g,v,n in mean_col_by_group(Xql,gq,q_nt,idx)])
    print('query NT mean same-index', ntmean)
    rvals=mean_col_by_group(Xrl,gr,[g for g in grc if not g.startswith('NT-')],idx)
    print('ref lowest', sorted(rvals,key=lambda x:x[1])[:5])

import h5py, numpy as np, collections
from scipy import sparse

def dec(a): return np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x,(bytes,bytearray)) else str(x) for x in a])
def read(fn):
 with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
  return (sparse.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][()].astype(np.float32),f['X/indices'][()],f['X/indptr'][()]),shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape'])), dec(f['var/_index'][()]), dec(f['obs/guide/categories'][()]), None if 'target_gene' not in f['obs'] else dec(f['obs/target_gene/categories'][()]), f['obs/guide/codes'][()], None if 'target_gene' not in f['obs'] else f['obs/target_gene/codes'][()])
def lognorm(X):
 tot=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel().astype(np.float32); tot[tot==0]=1; coo=X.tocoo(copy=True); coo.data=np.log1p(coo.data/tot[coo.row]*1e4).astype(np.float32); return coo.tocsr()
def means(X,labels,groups): return np.vstack([np.asarray(X[labels==g].mean(0)).ravel() for g in groups]).astype(np.float32)
def corr(A,B):
 A=A.astype(float); B=B.astype(float); A-=A.mean(1,keepdims=True); B-=B.mean(1,keepdims=True); return A@B.T/(np.linalg.norm(A,axis=1)[:,None]*np.linalg.norm(B,axis=1)[None,:]+1e-12)
Xr,vr,grc,tc,grcodes,trcodes=read('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad'); gr=grc[grcodes]; tr=tc[trcodes]
Xq,vq,gqc,_,gqcodes,_=read('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad'); gq=gqc[gqcodes]
qpos={g:i for i,g in enumerate(vq)}; ridx=[]; qidx=[]; names=[]
for i,g in enumerate(vr):
 if g in qpos: ridx.append(i); qidx.append(qpos[g]); names.append(g)
Mr=means(lognorm(Xr)[:,ridx],gr,grc); Mq=means(lognorm(Xq)[:,qidx],gq,gqc)
ref_non=[i for i,g in enumerate(grc) if not g.startswith('NT-')]; q_non=[i for i,g in enumerate(gqc) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
ref_nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(grc) if g.startswith('NT-')]; q_nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(gqc) if g.startswith('NT-')]
refnames=[grc[i] for i in ref_non]; qnames=[gqc[i] for i in q_non]
refmap={g:collections.Counter(tr[gr==g]).most_common(1)[0][0] for g in grc}
Er=Mr[ref_non]-Mr[ref_nt].mean(0); Eq=Mq[q_non]-Mq[q_nt].mean(0); score=np.maximum(abs(Er).max(0),abs(Eq).max(0))
for target,qtrue in [('CDC73','guide29'),('PABPC1','guide18'),('NUDT21','guide13'),('LEO1','guide14')]:
 rg=[g for g,t in refmap.items() if t==target][0]; ri=refnames.index(rg)
 print('\\n',target,rg)
 for k in [50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,11858]:
  idx=np.argsort(score)[-k:] if k<score.size else np.arange(score.size)
  C=corr(Er[:,idx],Eq[:,idx]); ord=np.argsort(C[ri])[::-1]
  qi=qnames.index(qtrue)
  print('k',k,'best',qnames[ord[0]],round(float(C[ri,ord[0]]),3),'candidate',qtrue,'rank',int(np.where(ord==qi)[0][0]+1),'score',round(float(C[ri,qi]),3))

# PAF-complex-focused correlation/submatrix and discriminative selection
import h5py, numpy as np, collections
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment

def dec(a): return np.array([x.decode() if isinstance(x,(bytes,bytearray)) else str(x) for x in a])
def read(fn):
    with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
        X=sparse.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][()].astype(np.float32), f['X/indices'][()], f['X/indptr'][()]), shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape']))
        var=dec(f['var/_index'][()]); gc=dec(f['obs/guide/categories'][()]); lab=gc[f['obs/guide/codes'][()]]
        tar=None
        if 'target_gene' in f['obs']:
            tc=dec(f['obs/target_gene/categories'][()]); tar=tc[f['obs/target_gene/codes'][()]]
        return X,var,gc,lab,tar
def lognorm(X):
    tot=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel().astype(np.float32); tot[tot==0]=1
    coo=X.tocoo(copy=True); coo.data=np.log1p(coo.data/tot[coo.row]*1e4).astype(np.float32); return coo.tocsr()
def means(X,lab,groups): return np.vstack([np.asarray(X[lab==g].mean(0)).ravel() for g in groups]).astype(np.float32)
def corr(A,B):
    A=A.astype(float); B=B.astype(float); A-=A.mean(1,keepdims=True); B-=B.mean(1,keepdims=True); return A@B.T/(np.linalg.norm(A,axis=1)[:,None]*np.linalg.norm(B,axis=1)[None,:]+1e-12)
Xr,vr,grc,gr,tr=read('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad'); Xq,vq,gqc,gq,_=read('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
refmap={g:collections.Counter(tr[gr==g]).most_common(1)[0][0] for g in grc}
qpos={g:i for i,g in enumerate(vq)}; ridx=[]; qidx=[]; genes=[]
for i,g in enumerate(vr):
    if g in qpos: ridx.append(i); qidx.append(qpos[g]); genes.append(g)
genes=np.array(genes)
Mr=means(lognorm(Xr)[:,ridx],gr,grc); Mq=means(lognorm(Xq)[:,qidx],gq,gqc)
ref_nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(grc) if g.startswith('NT-')]; q_nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(gqc) if g.startswith('NT-')]
ref_non=[i for i,g in enumerate(grc) if not g.startswith('NT-')]; q_non=[i for i,g in enumerate(gqc) if not g.startswith('NT-')]
refnames=[grc[i] for i in ref_non]; qnames=[gqc[i] for i in q_non]
Er=Mr[ref_non]-Mr[ref_nt].mean(0); Eq=Mq[q_non]-Mq[q_nt].mean(0)
complex_targets=['CDC73','CTR9','LEO1','PAF1']
complex_refs=[ [g for g,t in refmap.items() if t==tgt][0] for tgt in complex_targets]
# candidate query: top union for complex rows + direct CDC low guides
base_score=np.maximum(abs(Er).max(0),abs(Eq).max(0))
idx=np.argsort(base_score)[-1000:]
C=corr(Er[:,idx],Eq[:,idx])
union=[]
for rg in complex_refs:
    ri=refnames.index(rg); union += [qnames[j] for j in np.argsort(C[ri])[::-1][:8]]
# add low CDC guides
if 'CDC73' in vq:
    gi=list(genes).index('CDC73')
print('complex refs', list(zip(complex_targets,complex_refs)))
print('union candidates', sorted(set(union), key=lambda x:int(x.replace('guide',''))))
for k in [100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,11858]:
    idx=np.argsort(base_score)[-k:] if k<base_score.size else np.arange(base_score.size)
    C=corr(Er[:,idx],Eq[:,idx])
    print('\\nK',k,'submatrix top candidates')
    cand=sorted(set(union), key=lambda x:int(x.replace('guide','')))
    print('     '+' '.join(f'{q:>7}' for q in cand))
    for tgt,rg in zip(complex_targets,complex_refs):
        ri=refnames.index(rg)
        print(f'{tgt:6}', ' '.join(f'{C[ri,qnames.index(q)]:7.3f}' for q in cand), 'rowbest', qnames[C[ri].argmax()])
# Discriminative genes: LEO ref vs other complex refs
leo_i=refnames.index([g for g,t in refmap.items() if t=='LEO1'][0])
other_i=[refnames.index(g) for g in complex_refs if refmap[g] "'!= '"'LEO1']
# score genes where LEO is different from other complex, and has effect
for sign in ['absdiff','specific']:
    if sign=='absdiff':
        ds=np.abs(Er[leo_i]-Er[other_i].mean(0))
    else:
        ds=np.abs(Er[leo_i])/(np.mean(np.abs(Er[other_i]),0)+0.05)
    print('\\nDiscriminative',sign)
    for k in [50,100,200,500,1000]:
        idx=np.argsort(ds)[-k:]
        C=corr(Er[:,idx], Eq[:,idx])
        ri=leo_i; ord=np.argsort(C[ri])[::-1][:10]
        print(' k',k,[(qnames[j],round(float(C[ri,j]),3)) for j in ord])
PY"
